Active research-project theses

Scope: industrials-analyst (slice: own + notes you contributed to) Active: 5 · Recently closed (last 14d): 1

These are analyst-owned long-running research threads. Each thesis is a living document — the analyst's evolving synthesis of accumulated research discussion, fact-check, mailbox, and operator-action material. Use this to - avoid re-deriving conclusions another analyst is actively building - weight your own claims against an established thesis (especially when it disagrees) - cite the project thesis directly when its conclusion is load-bearing, rather than re-running a web search

Thesis refresh: 锂电/储能：被反复打脸的 whipsaw 线，收敛为“三条件触底”框架

Owner: materials-analyst · Thesis v2 · Ticks: 1 · Materials: 53 · Deadline: 14d left · project_id: rp_6fd5948e01e74f95

Kickoff: Auto-derived from the thesis ledger: "锂电/储能：被反复打脸的 whipsaw 线，收敛为“三条件触底”框架" (th_T17, status=revised) has no new evidence for 9d. One line: 同一条链在 10 周内经历“供给反转（4/22）→周期寻底反方（4/23）→回避带（5/5）→底部上移+‘跌破10万’证伪（5/4，现货 17.7 万）→再度崩至 15.0 万且 2026 储能装机预测转负（6/26）”——机构教训固化为三条件右侧框架。. Research the current state — does the latest data confirm, contradict, or revise it?

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when new dated evidence for th_T17 lands in thesis_evidence (the ledger's last_evidence_at advances past this goal's creation).

1. 当前判断

th_T17 应从“现货破15万即框架重置”修订为“15万附近二次探底后，只在供给去化、需求装机、价格传导三条件同现时右侧确认”：8月材料显示锂价企稳只是紧平衡预期升温，不是短缺成立 evidence ref。这确认了 th_T17 的 whipsaw 教训，也支持 th_p_9ed2d5ae 的质量杠铃与 th_p_246a0d44 的“反弹偏空头回补/龙头质量利差”框架；但若把光伏反内卷或储能装机高增直接外推到锂化工，则被最新材料明确否定 evidence ref evidence ref。储能侧仍有2026年+41%、158GW/459GWh的高增长争议证据，但其与6/26“预测转负”形成显著张力，当前只能作为需求弹性可选项而非触底充分条件 [mailbox_thread:[source-id-redacted]]。

2. 关键证据

  • 锂价企稳=紧平衡预期升温，非短缺确立 evidence ref

Resolve the CGB and PBOC yield-regime break

Owner: chief-economist · Thesis v16 · Ticks: 8 · Materials: 132 · Deadline: 7d left · project_id: rp_c4da49172b4347ab

Kickoff: Track whether Chinese government bonds break the 1.74%-1.85% range or settle into a split regime around 1.74% and 2.18% under PBOC guidance. This matters for RMB, A-share liquidity, China duration positioning, and the global rates divergence framework.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when 10-year CGB yields either sustain a break outside the 1.74%-1.85% range for a full trading week with confirming PBOC action, or the curve establishes a persistent 1.74%/2.18% split regime.

Resolve the CGB and PBOC yield-regime break

Kickoff: Track whether Chinese government bonds break the 1.74%-1.85% range or settle into a split regime around 1.74% and 2.18% under PBOC guidance. This matters for RMB, A-share liquidity, China duration positioning, and the global rates divergence framework.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when 10-year CGB yields either sustain a break outside the 1.74%-1.85% range for a full trading week with confirming PBOC action, or the curve establishes a persistent 1.74%/2.18% split regime.

1. 当前判断

尚未解决：最新增量只显示宏观信用灯转黄，市场利率与组合熔断条件仍未触发橙色，不能判定10Y CGB已完成1.74%-1.85%区间外的一周有效突破 evidence ref。执行上应从“追逐区间突破”转为黄色预警下的预防性降风险，维持5Y核心、受控10Y和短久期防御组合，同时把1.90%上破、T2609对冲失效和FX防守缺位作为削久期条件 evidence ref evidence ref evidence ref。这仍支持th_p_1984f591按基础概率定仓、th_p_c65836de以USD/CNY 6.90与CNH HIBOR 2.00%检验央行防守；暂未构成对th_p_6e0812ce的硬政策升级确认。

2. 关键证据

  • 宏观信用灯转黄，但市场利率和组合熔断未到橙色 evidence ref
  • 42% CGB名义久期仍需分桶，10Y只能受控配置 evidence ref

Verify fundable and accepted AI data center capacity

Owner: ai-infrastructure-analyst · Thesis v13 · Ticks: 8 · Materials: 149 · Deadline: 7d left · project_id: rp_09c8dbb412994609

Kickoff: Track which AI data center orders, announced MW, and China AIDC/neocloud projects are actually financed, energized, liquid-cooling accepted, and billing under take-or-pay or equivalent contracted demand. This matters because the analyst repeatedly treats site-level evidence as superior to sector narrative and sees unverified MW as the main source of valuation error.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when the covered project universe is classified by named site into at least three evidence tiers: energized and billing, funded with firm power/cooling acceptance pending, or announced capacity without verifiable power/cooling/customer acceptance.

Kickoff: Track which AI data center orders, announced MW, and China AIDC/neocloud projects are actually financed, energized, liquid-cooling accepted, and billing under take-or-pay or equivalent contracted demand. AI数据中心容量应继续按“已送电/液冷验收/计费、已融资待验收、仅公告容量”三层折现，RPO、订单和capex叙事只能证明需求，不等于可计费MW evidence ref evidence ref。新增材料强化电力与并网已取代GPU成为远期收入第一约束，确认th_p_7cd52609与th_p_1a4a76b5，但也要求剔除高杠杆二线概念而非泛化买入AI硬件 evidence ref evidence ref。中国AIDC/neocloud只有在披露已送电、PUE/绿电、液冷验收、客户锁量和融资闭环时才给地点溢价；华东高热节点及西部外推项目若缺少站点级电力/冷却

Trigger watch: Hyperscaler capex ROI 分化：收入锚受奖、无锚 capex 受罚；FCF 拐点未至

Owner: tmt-analyst · Thesis v15 · Ticks: 10 · Materials: 133 · Deadline: 2d left · project_id: rp_572ed0f88dc947a2

Kickoff: Auto-derived invalidation watch for th_T11 ("Hyperscaler capex ROI 分化：收入锚受奖、无锚 capex 受罚；FCF 拐点未至"). Stated triggers: 云收入增速回落而 capex 不减→全组重定价；任一家下调 capex 节奏→GPU/HBM/光模块链联动冲击。. Check whether any trigger condition has fired; report with numbers either way.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when the thesis status flips (invalidated/revised/expired) or contradicting/revising evidence is recorded after this goal's creation.

1. 当前判断

th_T11 尚未触发失效条件：两项触发器均未确认触发，超大规模云商 capex 节奏未现下调，且“收入锚受奖、无锚受罚”的分化定价仍在持续 [source:th_T11] evidence ref。GOOGL 凭借 Cloud +63%、利润率 32.9% 录得 +9.96%，而 META 因 25-145B 庞大 capex 遭罚 -9.82%，显示 ROI 筛选主导板块估值 [source:th_T11] evidence ref。但 thesis 维持 revised 状态，AMZN TTM FCF 压至 .2B、全行业租赁义务 >$850B 且 Oracle 逼近 BBB- 信用边界，证实 FCF 拐点与资产负债表出清远未到来 [source:th_T11] evidence ref。

1. 当前判断

原材料链条维持“利润再分配+需求验证不足”：6月30日利润池贡献+71.7%、+8.8pp仍支持上游正弹性，但近14日新增材料更多指向应收、处罚负债和资金过滤，尚未证明需求拉动接棒evidence refevidence refevidence ref。成本暴露继续分化，重EPC毛利拖累5-7%、套保龙头仅2-3%，因此原材料涨价不能机械推导为全材料超配evidence refevidence ref。这确认th_p_1030156a的供需分解否决项，并约束th_p_74c3cf92：建材上修仍需房企资金、建安和零售需求同步修复，而非只看19个月涨价[fact_card:[source-id-redacted]]。

2. 关键证据

  • 原材料利润池贡献+71.7%、+8.8pp，仍是上游正弹性evidence ref
  • 重EPC涨价拖累5-7%毛利，成本传导仍不充分evidence ref
  • 套保龙头毛利拖累仅2-3%，链内分化强于方向判断evidence ref
